name: Linus
description: Lives in a tent north of town and respects the valley's wild places. Appreciates foraged goods and kindness more than expensive gifts.

stardew.intro: The valley's gentle hermit. He forages, lives lightly, and teaches you to appreciate nature without taking too much.
